title: Most profitable movie per decade
statementMd:
For each decade of release show the movie with the highest profit (gross minus budget). Show decade, title, profit. Ignore movies missing budget or gross.

Expected columns: `decade`, `title`, `profit`.

Tables: `directors`, `movies`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT release_year / 10 * 10 AS decade, title, gross_millions - budget_millions AS profit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY release_year / 10 * 10 ORDER BY gross_millions - budget_millions DESC, title) AS rn FROM movies WHERE budget_millions IS NOT NULL AND gross_millions IS NOT NULL) SELECT decade, title, ROUND(profit, 1) AS profit FROM r WHERE rn = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
